About the Shiplap & Panels style

Shiplap is the friendliest wall in the catalog: horizontal painted boards, a chunky natural-wood mantel beam, and an electric fireplace below the TV. It brings farmhouse warmth into a room without turning the whole house into a theme.

Our version is built tighter than the DIY standard - boards fitted and caulked so the shadow lines stay even, the mantel beam is real timber rather than a hollow box, and the paint is a sprayed furniture finish in any color you pick. White is classic; deep green and navy are the current favorites.

It is also the most budget-friendly way into a finished TV wall, and it pairs naturally with floating shelves and LED lighting when you want a little more from the wall later.

Finishes

  • Paint in any color

Details & options

  • With or without mantel beam
  • Floating shelves
  • LED lighting
